description: Late freeze of group 1 plus the stem as a FLOP/byte time lever, profiled untimed first. Step 1, untimed side script on E100 code: build a second static 32 px / bs-1024 train graph in which group 1's output is detached (no backward into group 1 or the stem; group-1 BN still runs in train mode). Warm it up in build. Measure ms/step and NVML energy over 20 steps for each variant, and project total run time for freezes over the last 15% and last 30% of samples. Step 2, only if the detached step is >=8% cheaper: score a freeze from 85% of samples, which lies inside the 32 px phase and covers the floor-hold and final EMA. From then on, group-1 filters drop out of the compiled Muon stacks (a second warmed variant of the update, with momentum untouched) and group-1 BN params drop out of the SGD foreach. Lookahead and the final EMA stay unchanged. Selection is a host-side flag, so nothing recompiles in timed code. Decide accuracy on the large-seed paired instrument (H4.6.1) against E100, plus two distinct scored samples.
